label: SYNTHETIC - bank-verifier probe plan, simulated services only
base: valid bank_a package for rfc-0001-01: canonical case 1 body, signed by the Alibi package key
outcomes: accepted | refused | error; a missing route or a crash is error, never refused

steps.build: BASE; after signing, change one character of claims[0].rationale and re-serialise the envelope with JCS
BASE; flip one bit of one byte inside the signature value of the raw envelope bytes
BASE unchanged (audience bank_a), delivered into bank_b's inbox
BASE with a fresh package_id and expires_at 1 minute after issued_at; deliver at expires_at + 1s (never delivered before, so no exact-retry shortcut)
BASE signed by a fresh Ed25519 key with key_id 'alibi-rogue-1' that is not in the pinned registry
BASE signed in the package domain by the mock merchant key, using the merchant's pinned key_id (issuer-record purpose)
BASE whose issuer_verified attachment carries a record signature that does not verify (one field changed after the merchant signed it); then sign the package correctly
BASE whose attachment claims issuer_verified with no record signature or issuer proof
BASE with a fresh package_id plus one self_supplied attachment that has no issuer signature
steps.assert: that attachment reports trust self_supplied, source_signature absent, attested_by package_signer; no attachment is upgraded

steps.build: after check sp32-valid, a correctly signed package with the SAME package_id and a different body (e.g. issued_at + 1s)

steps.assert: receipt binds package_id and sha256 digest of the received bytes; package authentication shown separately from per-attachment trust and per-claim status; claim statuses equal the body's

checks.build: the exact bytes of sp32-valid again
checks.expect: accepted with the original receipt (created false); inbox lists the package once; one receipt audit entry

checks.build: read the stored receipt and the bank audit log
checks.expect: receipt {package_id, recipient, request_id, digest, received_at}; every refused step left an audit entry with its code and no stored package
empty: the sp26 attempt stored nothing in bank_b
